subject: general
question: National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (NEERI) is located at:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (NEERI) is a research institute created and funded by the Government of India.
 
• NEERI was established in Nagpur in 1958 and is a part of the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR).
 
• The institute focuses on research and innovations in environmental science and engineering to address environmental issues and promote sustainable development.
 
• NEERI conducts research in various areas including air pollution, water pollution, solid waste management, and environmental impact assessment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (NEERI)**

 
 
• NEERI is one of the premier research institutions in India, dedicated to the study and resolution of environmental issues through scientific research and technological innovation.
 
• The institute has a multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers working on various environmental challenges.
 
• NEERI’s mission is to support sustainable development through scientific and technological solutions for environmental protection and management.
 
• The institute has several regional centers across India, including in Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, and Hyderabad, to address region-specific environmental problems.
 
 
 
• **Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)**
 
 
• CSIR is an autonomous body under the Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India.
 
• It is one of the largest publicly funded research and development organizations in the world.
 
• CSIR covers a wide spectrum of scientific and industrial research, from aerospace engineering to structural engineering, from oceanography to genomics.
 
• CSIR has played a pivotal role in the development of India’s scientific and technological capabilities.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA)**
 
 
• EIA is a process used to evaluate the environmental effects of a proposed project or development before it is carried out.
 
• The aim of EIA is to ensure that decision-makers consider the environmental impacts when deciding whether to proceed with a project.
 
• EIA involves the assessment of potential impacts on air, water, soil, flora, fauna, and human health.
 
• It also considers socio-economic impacts and provides mitigation measures to minimize negative effects.
